title: EcoBalance
role: Explore predator-prey dynamics, feedback, stability, and collapse in changing ecological systems.
description: An interactive ecology model for comparing cycles, constraints, intervention, and system behavior over time.

api.notes: A shared browser and node-consumable API module now exists for the ecology remediation family.

tests.notes: A node-based contract test suite now exercises the shared ecology family API module.

provenance.summary: Public evo-edu framing over the legacy predator-prey implementation.
provenance.details: EcoBalance is the evo-edu public route for the predator-prey model family. The remediation pass now includes a direct responsive workbench using the shared ecology API while preserving the older predator-prey prototype as a legacy route.
limits: The older predator-prey prototype remains available as a legacy route.
Broader test coverage and ecological model refinement are still pending.
